description: This file contains server-side handler functions for managing workflow order updates and generating Prisma query filters based on user and filter inputs in a TypeScript project using Prisma ORM and tRPC.

methods.name: workflowOrderHandler
methods.description: Handles reordering of workflows based on input IDs, verifies user authorization, and updates workflow positions in the database.

methods.name: getPrismaWhereFromFilters
methods.description: Generates Prisma query filters based on user ID and provided filter criteria, supporting dynamic filter construction.
